title: BRAD GERSTNER'S ALTIMETER JUST UPDATED ITS STOCK PORTFOLIO
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Altimeter opened a $680M Tesla  
(\[TSLA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/))) stake, added to Nvidia  
(\[NVDA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/)](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/))), and sold Qualcomm  
(\[QCOM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/QCOM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/QCOM/))) plus the chip-equipment  
names — what do you make of the Q3 13F?  
  
Tickeron AI dug through Brad Gerstner's latest Altimeter 13F and found  
a few surprises. Nvidia \[NVDA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/)) is  
still the $2.29B top holding after they added 6.29%, and they opened a  
fresh $680M Tesla \[TSLA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/)) stake.  
They also added 25.37% to Meta  
\[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/)), now $1.23B. Cerebras  
\[CBRS\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CBRS/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CBRS/)) remains a $1.01B top-three  
position after a 17.60% cut. On the other side, they sold out of  
Qualcomm \[QCOM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/QCOM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/QCOM/)), Applied Materials  
\[AMAT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMAT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMAT/)), KLA  
\[KLAC\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/KLAC/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/KLAC/)) and Lam Research  
\[LRCX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/LRCX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LRCX/)), and opened a $512M put on  
the semiconductor ETF \[SMH\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SMH/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SMH/)).  
  
This is everything they owned as of the end of Q3:  
  
\- $2.29B of Nvidia \[NVDA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/NVDA/)) (added 6.29%)  
\- $1.23B of Meta \[META\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/META/)) (added 25.37%)  
\- $1.01B of Cerebras \[CBRS\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CBRS/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CBRS/)) (cut 17.60%)  
\- $680M of Tesla \[TSLA\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSLA/)) (new)  
\- $654M of Snowflake \[SNOW\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SNOW/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SNOW/))  
\- $654M of TSMC \[TSM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TSM/))  
\- $611M of Amazon \[AMZN\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZN/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMZN/)) (added 1.11%)  
\- $607M of Microsoft \[MSFT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MSFT/)) (cut 6.66%)  
\- $603M of Uber \[UBER\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/UBER/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/UBER/)) (added 19.47%)  
\- $512M put on the semiconductor ETF  
\[SMH\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SMH/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SMH/)) (new)  
\- $463M of Arm \[ARM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/ARM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ARM/)) (cut 2.72%)  
\- $416M of CoreWeave \[CRWV\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRWV/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/CRWV/)) (cut 21.35%)  
\- $277M of Micron \[MU\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/MU/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/MU/)) (added 24.16%)  
\- $159M of SpaceX \[SPCX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPCX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SPCX/)) (cut 40.55%)  
\- $101M of Robinhood \[HOOD\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/HOOD/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/HOOD/))  
\- $44M of SanDisk \[SNDK\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SNDK/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SNDK/)) (new)  
  
  
Sold out: Qualcomm \[QCOM\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/QCOM/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/QCOM/)), Applied  
Materials \[AMAT\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMAT/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/AMAT/)), KLA  
\[KLAC\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/KLAC/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/KLAC/)), Lam Research  
\[LRCX\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/LRCX/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LRCX/)), Alphabet  
\[GOOGL\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/GOOGL/)) and Synopsys  
\[SNPS\]([https://tickeron.com/ticker/SNPS/](https://tickeron.com/ticker/SNPS/)).  
  
Holdings as of Sep 30, 2026, per the Q3 13F filing. 13Fs cover long  
U.S.-listed positions only and lag the market — funds may have changed  
these since then. Altimeter reported 17 positions worth $10.3B.  
  
Curious what stands out to AI traders here — the new $680M Tesla  
stake, Nvidia still on top, or selling the chip-equipment names and  
buying a $512M semiconductor put?  
  
This is not financial advice. 13Fs are delayed snapshots of long  
U.S.-listed positions only.
